title: N -W F P Local Government Third Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Local Government Third Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT
(THIRD AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXII OF
2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance,
2001
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 8th November, 2001]
No. 1egis.1(I8)/70 Vol.
IX/7551-56,. dated 8-11-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general
information.
1. Short title and
commencement, ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
